description.value: Masala Junction is a family-owned Indian restaurant founded in 2013, drawing on over 25 years of culinary experience across India and Europe. The menu spans tandoori specialties, biryanis, curries, Indo-Chinese dishes, desi street food, and a range of house-made Indian sweets. Catering is available for weddings, corporate events, and private parties.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at masalajunction.net is live and corroborates the OSM record: the restaurant name, cuisine type, and phone number 604-590-8821 (not in OSM) are all confirmed. The menu includes a dedicated 'Vegetarian Specialities' section and the site explicitly mentions home deliveries and catering services, confirming takeout. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi) are mentioned anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM record has no phone number; website prominently lists 604-590-8821 — phone added from website.

Website marketing copy references 'Best Indian Cuisine in Surrey' while OSM community is listed as Tsawwassen (Delta); address on Scott Road/120 St straddles the Surrey–Delta boundary, likely not a significant issue.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active Indian restaurant with a live website, recent OSM check date (2025-05-26), and no indicators of closure.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu includes a dedicated 'Vegetarian Specialities' section plus multiple vegetarian appetizers (Vegetable Samosa, Aloo Tikki, Vegetable Pakora, Gobi Pakora, Onion Bhaji, Paneer Pakora, etc.)

price.label: Casual
price.signal: Main entrees $14–19; casual sit-down Indian restaurant
